originalTitle: AT&T shares jump 4% after strong Q2 earnings, raising buyback target
simplifiedContent: AT&T's stock price went up by 4% because the company had a good second quarter, meaning it made more money than expected. The company also added over a million new customers who use their advanced internet services. As a result, AT&T plans to buy back more of its own shares, which can help increase the stock price even more. This is good news for investors, as the company's revenue and income also increased compared to the same time last year. The company is confident about its future and confirmed its financial plans for the next few years, which likely contributed to the increase in stock price.

originalTitle: US Datawatch: Bill Gates' top 5 winning stocks of 2026; surged up to 55% YTD
simplifiedContent: Bill Gates, a well-known investor, has seen some of the stocks he owns do very well so far in 2026. In fact, his top 5 stocks have increased in value by as much as 55% since the start of the year. Some of the companies that have done well include Caterpillar, Madison Square Garden Sports, and FedEx. These gains show that certain areas of the economy, such as industrial, logistics, and entertainment, are doing well. This is good news for investors like Bill Gates, and it may also be a positive sign for the overall stock market.

originalTitle: IndusInd Bank among 5 stocks to hit 52-week highs & rally up to 15% in a month
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: IndusInd Bank and four other major stocks (Bajaj Auto, Federal Bank, Titan, and Nestle India) have recently reached their highest prices in the past year. This means that investors are very interested in buying these stocks, which has driven up their prices. Even though the overall market (measured by the Sensex) has been doing poorly, these five stocks have been doing well, with some rising as much as 15% in just a month. This suggests that investors are confident in these companies and are willing to buy their stocks, even when the rest of the market is struggling. This is a positive sign for these companies and their investors.

originalTitle: Multibagger defence stock Apollo Micro Systems to be in focus tomorrow; here's why
simplifiedContent: Apollo Micro Systems, a company that makes defense products, is expected to be in the news tomorrow. This is because it just received an important order from the Indian Navy for a project called SAVIOR-ASW. The project is about making autonomous maritime warfare systems, which means using technology to help India monitor and protect its waters, especially in the Indian Ocean. This order is a big deal because it shows that the Indian Navy trusts Apollo Micro Systems to help with this important project. This could be good news for investors who own the company's stock, as it could lead to more business and growth for the company.

originalTitle: Recently listed Indo SMC bags  ₹66.6 crore order from engineering firm; stock jumps 190% from March lows
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening: Indo SMC, a recently listed company, just got a big order worth ₹66.6 crore from an engineering firm. This order is for something called Variable Frequency Drive panels and needs to be completed by July 31, 2026. The company's stock price has jumped a lot - 190% - since its low point in March, which is a big increase. This matters because the order and the company's increased profit (now at ₹32 crore) are signs that the company is doing well, which is why investors are excited and buying its stock. As a result, the company's stock price is going up.

originalTitle: Wall Street: S&P 500, Nasdaq edge lower as chip stocks dip, big tech earnings in focus
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market: the main groups of stocks, called the Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq, had a mixed day. The Dow went up a little, by 0.12%, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq went down, by 0.16% and 0.56% respectively. This happened because some technology stocks, especially those related to computer chips, didn't do well. The market is also waiting to see how big technology companies will perform when they release their earnings reports. This matters because it can affect the overall direction of the stock market and the value of investors' portfolios.
